invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new instance of HoodieJavaTable (either HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable or HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable) and never returns null.
The method only handles these two table types; other types result in exception and no return.
The only return types possible are exactly these two subclasses.
